wnba.Headline: Mercury legend Diana Taurasi hopes to join ownership group
wnba.Description: Two days before her No. 3 will be retired by the Phoenix Mercury, Diana Taurasi told ESPN that she hopes to join Mercury ownership in the next year or two.

wnba.Headline: Aces hold off Mystics, lock up postseason berth behind Young's 32
wnba.Description: Jackie Young scored 32 points to help the Aces clinch a playoff berth with an 83-76 win over the Mystics on Thursday night.

wnba.Headline: Aces secure playoff spot with 83-76 victory over the Mystics
wnba.Description: — Jackie Young had a season-high 32 points and five 3-pointers, A’ja Wilson added 15 points and the Las Vegas Aces secured a playoff spot with an 83-76 victory over the Washington Mystics on Thursday night.

wnba.Headline: Ionescu scores 20 points and Liberty avoid record collapse to hold off Sparks
wnba.Description: — Sabrina Ionescu scored 20 points and the New York Liberty avoided one of the biggest collapses in WNBA history, holding off the Los Angeles Sparks 85-81 on Thursday night.

wnba.Headline: Howard, Gray each score 29 points as the Dream ease by the Sun 104-69
wnba.Description: — Rhyne Howard scored 29 points and made five 3-pointers, Allisha Gray also had 29 points, and the Atlanta Dream eased by the Connecticut Sun 104-69 on Thursday night.

wnba.Headline: Liberty's Sabally stepping away from team to deal with head injury
wnba.Description: Satou Sabally, who hasn't played since suffering a concussion in June, will take time away from the team as she recovers from a head injury.

wnba.Headline: Boston, Mitchell disappointed by Fever fans booing White
wnba.Description: Fever All-Stars Aliyah Boston and Kelsey Mitchell supported coach Stephanie White on Thursday, saying they were disappointed by the boos during White's introduction at Tuesday's home game.

wnba.Headline: Diana Taurasi tales: Untold stories about retired WNBA legend
wnba.Description: "We got Diana" ... and you don't forget a legend like that. Here's a look at Diana Taurasi from teammates who knew her best.

wnba.Headline: Diana Taurasi and the shot that made WNBA scoring history
wnba.Description: In an exclusive interview, the WNBA's most prolific scorer helped ESPN break down the shot that scored 10,000 points.
